package com.epitech.depthdiablo.loot
Loot: what monsters drop, the loot table it is drawn from and the items lying on the floor.

    Description
    ItemDrop
    An item lying on the ground (GDD 1.4): dropped by a monster or by the player, or placed in a room.
    ItemDropper
    Puts items on the ground (GDD 1.4): the one entry point for an item appearing in the world.
    LootDrops
    Drops an item of the loot table where an enemy dies (GDD 1.4); the table makes rare items drop less often.
    LootTable
    Picks the item a dead enemy drops (GDD 1.4): first a rarity, by its share of the drops, then one entry of data/items.json of that rarity, each with the same chance.
